supporting_pages.title: "Transfer from a file system to Cloud Storage \_|\_ Storage Transfer Service\
evidence_snippets: Transfer options : Specify whether to overwrite destination files ( --overwrite-when=different or always ) and whether to delete certain files during or after the transfer ( --delete-from=destination-if-unique or source-after-transfer ); specify which metadata values to preserve ( --preserve-metadata ); and optionally set a storage class on transferred objects ( --custom-storage-class ).
Under When to overwrite , select one of the following: Never : Storage Transfer Service skips transferring any files from the source that have the same name as a file present in the destination.
Logging Storage Transfer Service supports Cloud Logging for Storage Transfer Service (recommended) as well as agent-based transfer logs .
